greasingProtocol.frequency: Every 2 to 3 operating hours during active rock breaking
greasingProtocol.procedure: Keep breaker vertical with chisel pressed firmly against hard rock to ensure grease coats the upper and lower bushings without entering the hydraulic piston chamber.

nitrogenPressureMaintenance.checkInterval: Inspect nitrogen pressure every 100 to 150 operating hours
nitrogenPressureMaintenance.symptomOfLowN2: Reduced impact energy, slower strike rate, elevated hydraulic hose vibration
nitrogenPressureMaintenance.symptomOfExcessN2: Irregular strikes, excessive recoil transferred into the excavator boom

blankFiringPrevention.definition: Striking with the hydraulic breaker when the chisel is not in contact with rock or concrete.
blankFiringPrevention.damageCaused: Piston impact directly into front head, causing broken tie-rods, retainer pins, and fractured cylinders.
blankFiringPrevention.disdSafetyFeature: DISD heavy breakers integrate an auto-cushion anti-blank firing valve that diverts hydraulic pressure harmlessly when the chisel is fully extended.

hydraulicOilQuality.oilType: Anti-wear hydraulic oil ISO VG 46 (Moderate climate) or ISO VG 68 (Desert Middle East heat)
hydraulicOilQuality.filtration: Return line filter rating must be 10 microns or finer
hydraulicOilQuality.maximumOilTemp: Should not exceed 80°C (176°F) under peak ambient desert conditions.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What is DISD and what does the company manufacture?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Dragon International Services & Development LLC (DISD) is an international heavy equipment manufacturer and distributor. We engineer Japanese Komatsu KES-compliant hydraulic breakers, rough-terrain forklifts, excavators, compaction equipment, and heavy demolition attachments with regional headquarters in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Where is DISD located in Saudi Arabia?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Our regional sales, technical engineering, and spare parts depot is located on Jazan Public Road, Al Jawharah District, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia (حي، طريق جازان العام, Al Jawharah, Jeddah). Direct phone: +966-543732208.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: How do I choose the correct hydraulic breaker for my excavator?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Match your excavator operating weight to the breaker's recommended carrier range. For example, a 20-30 ton excavator (e.g. CAT 320, Komatsu PC200) pairs with our 140mm chisel DISD-TB210 (1,850 - 3,200 kg). Verify your carrier provides 150-190 L/min oil flow at 160-180 bar operating pressure.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Will a DISD breaker fit my CAT, Komatsu, Volvo, or Hyundai excavator?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes. Every DISD breaker is supplied with a tailor-machined adapter mounting bracket matching your excavator's exact pin diameter, stick ear width, and center-to-center distance, ensuring 100% plug-and-play installation.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What is the difference between Triangular, Box (Silenced), and Side-Type breakers?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Triangular breakers offer high maneuverability, easy maintenance access, and lower cost for open quarries. Box-type (silenced) breakers feature fully enclosed sound-dampened housings ideal for municipal urban demolition. Side-type breakers offer maximum upward reach for high-wall scaling and tunneling.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What warranty does DISD provide on machinery?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: We offer a 24-month structural warranty and a 12-month core hydraulic warranty on our hydraulic breaker range, and up to 24 months / 3,000 operating hours on excavators. All warranty claims are backed by our Jeddah regional depot with 24-hour response turnaround.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Are spare parts (chisels, seal kits, diaphragms, bushings) readily available?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes. Our Jeddah warehouse maintains inventory of high-wear consumables including forged moil/wedge/blunt chisels, Parker/NOK polyurethane seal kits, nitrogen accumulators, and Hardox wear plates for immediate dispatch.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: How quickly can I get a quotation?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Our commercial engineering team delivers an official proforma quotation with technical matching sheets within 24 business hours. You can request a quote via our website RFQ form or by emailing shoaib@deepaxis.cn.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What shipping terms do you support?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: We support FOB, CIF Jeddah Port, CIF King Abdulaziz Port (Dammam), and local road delivery throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and GCC countries.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: How often should I grease the hydraulic breaker?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Grease the tool bushings every 2 to 3 operating hours using molybdenum disulfide chisel paste. Always keep the breaker pressed firmly down against the ground while greasing to prevent paste from contaminating the hydraulic piston seals.
